ai.title: The AFCON Final SCANDAL Is Finally Over PT.1
script: I need you to understand exactly how insane this AFCON situation has been for the last ten months.
Senegal walked off the pitch in January after a controversial one-nil win against Morocco.
Then, the Confederation of African Football somehow stripped them of the title and handed it to Morocco in March.
It took three hundred and ten days and three separate legal proceedings in Switzerland to fix this.
The Court of Arbitration for Sport has now officially reinstated Senegal as the true 2025 champions.
They ruled that the referee's original decision on the pitch must remain final and sacrosanct.
